title: ops scp sft model to westd

content.text:

|------|-----------|-------------|------|

| 总大小 | 3.3G | 3.3G | ✓ |
| model.safetensors | 3,441,185,608 bytes | 3,441,185,608 bytes | ✓ |
| tokenizer.json | 11,422,654 bytes | 11,422,654 bytes | ✓ |
| 时间戳 | May 15 10:57 | May 15 10:57 | ✓ |
